payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the proposed multimodal NER (MNER) model learns from both text and images, integrating visual information with textual data to enhance performance.

claims.text: The MNER model combines visual information with textual information to improve NER performance.
The model incorporates a deep image network to augment textual information for NER tasks.
The approach is the first to incorporate visual contexts for named entity recognition tasks.
